_note: Proposed harvest-stage schema for DELPHI statement expansion. Sits IN FRONT of the existing registry schema (lean/registry/laws-registry.schema.json); an accepted statement is handed to lean/registry/propose.mjs, which never auto-accepts.

schema.kind: identity | inequality-bound | scaling-exponent | numeric-observation | ontology-axiom | qualitative
schema.level: genotype | population | physiology | phenotype | developmental | empirical observation (as in lean/laws.json)

source.locator: DOI, URL, BNID or repo path
source.opened: true only if an agent fetched it

schema.lean_pattern: P1 algebraic identity | P2 inequality/bound | P3 uniqueness/optimum | P4 conditional on named hypothesis | P5 observation structure (no axiom) | P0 none
hypotheses: every assumption, named; a named hypothesis is not a proof

validation.holdout_checked: bool: holdout/check-leaks.mjs exit 0 on every file touched

schema.status: harvested | triaged | lean-drafted | kernel-checked | data-validated | nanopub-draft-unsigned | rejected

examples.statement_en: For a Hill gate the 10%-to-90% input span is 81^(1/n), independent of the threshold K.

source.evidence_quote: the 10%-to-90% input span is 81^(1/n), independent of K

validation.pass_criterion: fitted n unchanged across threshold variants (empirical claim, NOT proved)

examples.statement_en: For neutral mutations the long-run substitution rate equals the mutation rate, independent of population size.

source.locator: lean/laws.json (source: Evolutionary Rate at the Molecular Level, 1968)
source.evidence_quote: equals the mutation rate per generation, independent of population size

hypotheses: independent fates of mutants (by definition, not proved)

examples.statement_en: The series (Reuss) stiffness of a two-phase composite never exceeds the parallel (Voigt) stiffness.

source.evidence_quote: check.sh must FAIL on this file

triage.reason: convexity inequality; the reversed claim is the negative control

examples.statement_en: Measured area scaling exponent E1 is 1.834 in the project's empirical layer.

source.evidence_quote: An observation is not a mathematical truth, so this layer declares NO axiom

triage.reason: observation structure with fields and inequality obligations; number cross-checked file vs Lean module

examples.statement_en: TEMPLATE ONLY: a BioNumbers entry (value, range, organism, conditions, primary reference) cited by its 6-digit BNID.

source.citation: Milo et al. Nucl. Acids Res. (2010) 38 (suppl 1): D750-D753
source.evidence_quote: recommended that you also specify the BioNumbers 6 digit ID

triage.reason: no BNID opened by this agent; value deliberately left null
blocked_by: licence text not found on site
primary reference must be opened, not just the BNID row
